desc: Chalk is a incredibly useful magic tool that allows you to transmute catalysts into various reactions. Limited uses.
Fishing rods lets you catch food with little issue.
A wand is a magical tool that allows someone to control the output of their spells.
A staff is a magical tool that augments and helps control the output of spells.
Limited uses, based on magic power. Allows you to check the ritual cost of a specific ritual and it's energy amount. Will let you also destroy a ritual if it's just about to start up.
Allows you to dig. Slowly...
A gross alternative that feeds you at least. Harder to eat than regular food.
Chests let you store stuff in them.
Magic Sifters will give you ingredients to use in rituals.
A crafting bench lets you make various items. It also lets you make clothes manually out of Zenni. (This is the only way to make custom clothes!)
Keys let you enter passworded Doors without having to enter in the password every time. They also let you set passwords on doors!
A single ammo box will reload a weapon with its maximum capacity of rounds. Blasters don't need this
Research Stations are pretty important. They're the only really good way of getting Tech XP at all, along with certain robotic modules.

Ingredient Bags are like ingredient crystals, except without the limitless storage (up to 20 items), and portable. However, if you retrieve an ingredient over a ritual, it will automatically add that ingredient to the ritual.
Handguns are slow firing, relatively weak ranged weapons for those who are Ki deficient.
SMGs are faster than Handguns, but deal less base damage.
Slower than a SMG, but loads of range and damage.
Small clip size, small range... but loads of damage. Long reload time.
For those with DAKKA issues. You may romantically call this the Boomstick.
Weighs you down and improves training.
Fabricators allow you to create technology on the fly.
Armor is a protective layer that helps reduce incoming damage. Despite this, it's boosts start becoming minor.
Ingredient Crystals will collect all ingredients in a 10 tile radius, and store them efficiently inside them. But only while bolted
Sealing Jars are jars that are required for various sealing techniques. Suffice to say, if you don't have a sealing technique, you don't need it.
Recharge stations are capable of bringing you up to 100% pretty quickly. Too bad they aren't portable.
Books! Functionally useless, but are technically shitpost-pads.
A Ki based solution to the DAKKA deficient.
Refridgerators let you store food items for long periods of time.
Slowly heal wounds using bandages. Must stay still while using, and can be used on others.
Allows you to dig a bit faster.
Same as a book, but is current year. Also, serves as a portable Bounty Computer if you upgrade it. Can also view any cameras placed.
Same as a book, but is current year. Also, serves as a portable Bounty Computer if you upgrade it.
Increases Max Energy gain, increases Energy drain.
Increases Max Energy gain, increases Energy drain.
Pretty to look at. Gives off King Kong vibes for some reason.
Punching this will double your training gains.
Punching this will broadcast your per-punch damage. (And how much you can lift.)
Scouters let you view the power of others around you, communicate, and more.
Medical Scanners let you scan others or yourself for information about biologies.
A blood bag is a basic container used to store liquid blood indefinitely. Only has positives for Vampires.
Automatically heals all barriers in its range every minute. Will not bring back already destroyed barriers. Turf walls don't have health! Use Wall Upgrader for walls!
Place it down, bolt it, set a frequency and you can view it from a PDA, Camera Computer, or a Master Communicator.
Smoke bombs don't do any damage. They are annoying though, and they create smoke that lasts for like, 20 seconds. They're also really bad on my sinuse- Don't you fucking buy them, you little shit!
Can view cameras from anywhere. Needs the corrosponding camera frequency.
A collection of various tools and spare parts used to repair artificial limbs.
A mechanical kit is needed to instal modules and uninstall them.
Boats allow you to sail across the open waters freely.
Bolters can be used to bolt things you own down. Also is a gun.
Automatically heals all barriers. Upon manual activation (click it.) it'll upgrade all objects in range, including itself.
Destroy barriers and tiles in a small radius around you. This will destroy most items in the game!
A virus synthesizer allows you to create various viruses that modify your body or those around you. Or make Anti-viruses.
Will point you in the general direction and area of a dungeon, but not the actual coordinates.
Spacesuits are easier to make than Rebreathers, but are pretty cumbersome on looks. They also have communication functionality.
A personal field base. The owner can store items here and rest to recover HP and Ki. Only the owner can dismantle it.
Heal barriers on the fly! Heals all barriers in a small radius around you.
A master communicator is capable of recieving messages from all machines capable of sending them, on multiple frequencies.
A kit filled with various medical supplies. Can be used to heal, and has multiple uses.

Recreators use resources to recreate sections of tiles. Activate it via clicking it, selecting two points. It'll save just the turfs and buildable objects in those two points. You can download, and upload, this savefile. It'll cost 10 zenni per turf, 100 zenni per build object. Maximum 30 by 30 size.
Power Drills let you create large amounts of cash without needing to dig yourself.
Rebreathers let you breathe in space.
Rocket Ships are basically just one-use pods. They're more expensive to make, but pretty easy to build.
Forcefields will absorb incoming Ki attacks at the price of it's own armor.
Detonators can remotely trigger any bombs if given the right code.
Regenerators let you slowly regenerate HP, Ki, and a very small amount of Stamina.
A personal spacepod for interplanetary travel. Use the Launch verb to fly to your selected destination planet.
Spacepods allow you to fly out into space and visit other worlds.
Dragon Radars let you locate any item, provided you set the radar to that item in the first place.
Simulators create mobs for you to defeat.
A ball whose ability is to capture the DNA of fallen foes and recreate them into a customizable and trainable servant.
Give it to an out companion or a companion inside a capturer to increase their intelligence.

Stunguns can stun people, instantly KOing them. Naturally, this doesn't work on people with high health above 100 BP, and are not relaxed. Each shot is pretty expensive too. Best used on already weakened or downed opponents.
A fortified personal stronghold. Sturdier than a Base Camp and provides faster HP and Ki recovery for the owner.

A omni watch does really only one thing- teleport. You can teleport between other watches, or telepads. Works sorta like a Shunkan Ido teleport- it takes longer depending on the distance multiplied by Z-level. You can also wire it to speak to other watches on the same channel, and to give you clothes on clicking.
Toxic Waste is, well, toxic waste. It doesn't really have a use... You won't fling it near anyone, right!? That's not how it works!!

Mainframe de criacao de androides. Aparafuse (Bolt) e INSTALE um laboratorio: Android Lab (transforme-se em androide por Absorcao ou Energia Infinita) ou Bio-Android Lab (extraia DNA de jogadores nocauteados e geste um Bio-Androide). A instalacao exige um Humano com muita inteligencia.
Gravitys shunt out massive amounts of force around it. The force may be harmful to you, but it makes for some excellent training grounds.
The Doll Core is a very unique capsule with a human-type specimen capable of great growth, but is quite weak. It's intelligence is quite high.
Nav systems automatically collect and categorize all planets capable of hosting sentient life, along with a autopilot and Space GPS.
A massive personal starship: walk inside, take the bridge, and launch to space. The most advanced craft you can build.

A localized teleport nullifier. Will prevent anyone on the same Z-Level from teleporting for about a minute or so. (This includes yourself!) Can be manually turned off, and they don't require being bolted to work.
Requires also a seed food item. The Saibaman Capsule creates a genetically grown super warrior stronger than many men. It's loyal- but it's also vicious.
A DNA container is used to input DNA into a cloning machine so that the person's body may be used.
The Intercepter Core is a unique capsule that creates a small intelligent drone capable of shooting down Ki blasts.
Telepads are slim floorbound devices that serve as bases for teleportation. They're what you need to be able to teleport effectively.
A small tower that emits specialized waves that heal everyone nearby it. (Range is 20)
Nukes are very destructive, very big blasts. They absolutely eradicate terrain. Creating one also creates toxic waste.
DUN DAH DUN DUN DUH DUN DA... *guitar riff* Basically a better blaster. This is only in the game because Sans got into Smash.
A super computer to deal with ALL of your robot armies!
Emits massive amounts of Blutzwaves, the phenomena, which at regular levels will drive a Saiyan into their Oozaru! This emits much, much more than that.

Have you ever gotten old by a lot? It sucks. Well, if you use a DNA cloning device, store the device, and then use it here, you can get a younger self! Caution: Younger Self may be self-aware. Younger Self also will not have most of it's power at time of collection.
Boats allow you to sail across the open waters freely.
Spacepods allow you to fly out into space and visit other worlds.
